entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives messages and performs reactions according to 3GPP specifications.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network infrastructure that sends messages and follows specified procedures.

entities.name: Semantically incorrect message
entities.description: A received message that contains semantically incorrect contents as defined in the specification.

entities.name: Procedural reactions
entities.description: Reactions specified in clauses 5 and 6 of TS 24.501 for handling various message scenarios.

entities.name: Status message
entities.description: A message returned by the UE indicating status, either 5GMM STATUS or 5GSM STATUS depending on the EPD.

entities.name: Cause #95 semantically incorrect message
entities.description: A cause value indicating that the received message was semantically incorrect.

relations.description: UE performs procedural reactions when receiving a semantically incorrect message.
Semantically incorrect message triggers procedural reactions if specified.
UE sends status message when no procedural reactions are specified for semantically incorrect message.
Status message includes cause #95 indicating semantically incorrect message.
Network follows same procedure as UE but typically does not transmit status message.
